responsibility: Declares the interface between GCC’s DWARF generator and the CTF/BTF subsystem. The header provides the entry points used by dwarf2out.cc to initialize CTF translation, feed DWARF DIEs into CTF/BTF construction, run any postprocessing, and finish early or late emission, and it exposes wrappers for retrieving file, line, and column source-location information from DWARF DIEs so the CTF container and BTF CO-RE machinery need not access DWARF internals directly.
same_name_distinction: Declares the bridge interface that lets dwarf2out.cc drive CTF/BTF generation from DWARF, plus wrapper accessors for DIE source locations; the actual DIE traversal and translation logic lives in dwarf2ctf.cc.
